Bug_Title: MS: Field is a mutable collection (MS_MUTABLE_COLLECTION)
Bug_Details:
A mutable collection instance is assigned to a final static field,
  thus can be changed by malicious code or by accident from another package.
  Consider wrapping this field into Collections.unmodifiableSet/List/Map/etc.
  to avoid this vulnerability.
Bug_Explanation: A mutable collection (ArrayList) is assigned to a final static field 'mutableList'. This allows modification of the collection from any part of the program, leading to potential unintended changes or security vulnerabilities.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testMutableListModification' calls the 'showBug' method which modifies the 'mutableList', a publicly exposed static final mutable collection. This leads to unexpected modification of the collection, violating the immutability principle, which demonstrates the vulnerability.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the test passed successfully without any errors or failures, suggesting that the mutable collection was modified as expected. This does not confirm the presence of the bug as described, which would involve unintended or malicious modification from outside the intended scope.
